text:
Ethan (Partnerships): quick sync 3 we9re aiming to list partners in the cloud marketplace on Fri Jun 21. main deliverables: partner quote, logo (SVG), one-line blurb, SI integration checklist, demo clip. who takes each?
Maya (Marketing): I9ll take press + blog. need partner-approved quotes by Wed noon or we'll slip. will draft co-authored outline. utm_campaign=partner-market-jun21
Rory (Design): I9ll build the hero and partner carousel. request original-color SVG + clearspace rules. need a 1280x720 thumbnail for the demo video.
Kemi (Legal): logos require signed usage form. no public quotes until legal signoff. I'll post the checklist and tag partners.
Jon (Eng): integration docs: I9ll publish "Marketplace Listing Quickstart" v0.1 with sample curl and the private_preview flag. need sample payloads and SKU mapping from hardware partners.
Anya (PM): rollout note: Dedicated customers must be excluded from public listing until billing/contract gating is complete. Jon, can you toggle private_preview per tenant?
Jon (Eng): yes, metadata supports tenant-scoped private_preview. will add example JSON and access control note.
Ethan (Partnerships): hardware partner (NodeWave) requested a "Powered by NodeWave" badge. Kemi, any special brand constraints?
Kemi (Legal): brand form + placement rules required. will attach template.
reminderbot: scheduled_reminder: "Partner assets due Wed 12:00" -> pings Maya and Ethan if not uploaded.
Maya (Marketing): I'll prepare the embargo email draft; press list ready once legal clears.
Rory (Design): dropping a Figma link in the doc and will export PNG/JPG variants by Thu AM.
Ethan (Partnerships): owners recap: Press - Maya; Quotes & logos - partners (Ethan to chase); Legal - Kemi; Design - Rory; Integration docs & private flag - Jon; PM gating - Anya. Dry run Thu 09:00 PT. react with :thumbsup: when you own your item.
